subject: Transition plan: tiered GPU rightsizing, validation windows & blackout coordination
messages:
From: Dana Lee <dana@helixai.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted -> Dedicated: initial sizing details and ask

Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we discussed, HelixAI is targeting a committed Dedicated pool for our inference workloads (customer-facing chat + batch embeddings). We pulled together a short requirements sheet (attached) and a first-pass traffic profile. Highlights:

- Peak QPS (inference requests): ~420 req/s
- Typical prompt length: 120 tokens, completion avg 180 tokens
- Target p95 latency <= 120ms, p99 <= 250ms for hosted SLA equivalence
- KV cache use (session-based) is expected to reduce effective tokens by ~25% for chat flows
- We want a canary window, then a 48hr smoke/observability period, and a final cutover blackout of 1 hour

Can your team propose an acceptance/validation timeline and preliminary GPU sizing (types + counts) that will give us headroom for 1.5x to 2x traffic spikes? Also listing any preflight tests you want us to run from our side.

Attached: helix_migration_requirements.xlsx

-Dana
Customer Success, HelixAI
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Dana Lee <dana@helixai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted -> Dedicated: initial sizing details and ask

Dana — thanks for the sheet, looks comprehensive. High-level response and proposed timeline below. I pulled in Marissa for scheduling and Ben/karthik for technical acceptance gates.

Prelim sizing (conservative, accommodates 2x short spikes):
- Primary fleet: 6 x H100-80GB (for latency-sensitive chat models)
- Fallback pool: 4 x A100-80GB (for batch/embeddings + cost-effective fallbacks)
- Autoscale cushion: configured to allow +2 transient H100 instances for short bursts (billing considerations to be confirmed)

Target capacity rationale: modeled against your profile with 1.5x baseline and p99 constraints; H100s keep sequence throughput and tail latency tight with KV cache enabled. We recommend enabling our prefix caching for sessions to reach the ~25% token reduction you noted.

Validation and cutover windows (proposal):
1) Preflight (week of Nov 9): deploy Dedicated stack in staging, run throughput and tail-latency bench (internal).
2) Customer smoke (Nov 16–17): Helix runs representative traffic with mirrored requests (no live traffic). Acceptance criteria: sustained QPS >= 420, p99 <= 250ms, no dropped requests, memory/eviction rates within expected.
3) Canary (Nov 23): route 5% live traffic to Dedicated for 4 hours, monitor health + costs.
4) Observability window (Nov 24–25): 48hr monitoring with escalations wired to on-call.
5) Cutover (Nov 30): 60-minute blackout window for final DNS/proxy switch; rollback plan ready if metrics breach thresholds.

Requirements from Helix: provide a 24hr representative traffic replay for Nov 16–17 and confirm top-3 prompt templates we should use for latency-sensitive testing.

I'll let Ben and Karthik add technical acceptance criteria and the runbook. Marissa — can you propose times for the preflight week?

Thanks,
Hannah
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Dana Lee <dana@helixai.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 15:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted -> Dedicated: initial sizing details and ask

Adding technical acceptance gates and preflight checklist — please see inline.

Acceptance gates (must pass to move from smoke -> canary -> full cutover):
- Throughput: batch and online tests verify sustained token throughput >= 2,000 tokens/s aggregate for the H100 pool while maintaining p95 latency < 120ms
- Tail latency: p99 <= 250ms on 95% of trials for a 30-minute sustained window at 1.5x baseline
- Memory stability: KV cache miss rate < 7% over a 1 hour run; model KV size within projected bounds (no OOMs)
- Error budget: total 5xx error rate < 0.05% during smoke/canary; any regression above that triggers immediate rollback
- Cold-start distribution: first-token latency for cold workers should not exceed 300ms median; we will warm key models via our warmup script prior to canary

Preflight checklist (staging):
- Deploy same model variants (quantization profile as in hosted) and confirm kernel selection matches H100 for the critical path
- Run our continuous batching harness with your replay for a 2 hour window at 1.5x traffic
- Run stress test at 2x peak for 15 minutes to verify autoscale and billing alarms don't inadvertently trigger capacity throttles
- Confirm metrics ingestion (Prometheus traces) and alert hooks to Helix SRE pager; add log sampling for first 48h

Attachments: rightsizing_estimate_v3.csv (contains model-level expected tokens/s per card)

I will prepare a short runbook (cutover-runbook-draft.pdf) and a rollback checklist.

-karthik
Sr. Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Dana Lee <dana@helixai.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted -> Dedicated: initial sizing details and ask

Dana / team — proposed scheduling notes and blackout coordination.

Preflight week: Nov 9–13 (staging run) — I'll block 2-hour daily windows (10:00–12:00 PT) for bench runs; please confirm availability for your replay traffic.
Customer smoke: Nov 16 09:00 PT — Nov 17 17:00 PT (24hr sampled replay + 24hr extended observability)
Canary: Nov 23 09:00–13:00 PT (route 5% live; 4 hours)
Observability: Nov 24–25 (48 hours)
Cutover: Nov 30 02:00–03:00 PT (we recommend this off-peak hour for minimal user impact).

Blackout coordination (what will be inaccessible):
- Model management UI changes (write ops blocked) during final config sync (~5–10 mins)
- DNS switch propagation: we expect <60 minutes for full routing; application traffic may see transient 502s if rollback triggers

Rollback criteria (automatic/manual):
- Any sustained p99 > 250ms for 15 minutes AND error rate > 0.1% -> manual rollback
- Any outage affecting >2% of user sessions -> immediate rollback

Please confirm the off-peak cutover time works for Helix. I'll create a shared calendar invite and a brief runbook link.

-Marissa
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Dana Lee <dana@helixai.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Ravi Patel <ravi@helixai.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted -> Dedicated: initial sizing details and ask

Thanks — this looks good and conservative in the right way. Nov 9–13 preflight windows are fine; we'll deliver the 24hr replay by EOD Nov 6 and confirm top prompt templates by Nov 8. Off-peak cutover (Nov 30 02:00 PT) works for us.

Action items we own:
- Provide 24hr replay + top-3 prompt templates (by Nov 6)
- Run our internal connectivity check for new endpoints (by Nov 12)

Action items for Redwood:
- Share the final cutover-runbook and pager escalation list (by Nov 10)
- Confirm exact H100/A100 instance SKUs and billing implications for autoscale cushion (by Nov 12)

We'll plan an alignment call on Nov 5 to walk through the replay and runbook. Thanks everyone for moving fast on timing.

-Dana
Customer Success, HelixAI
